digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow — macOS pytest execution
propositions: RAM-disk experiment was rejected because all four treatment runs completed macOS default suite slower than the no-RAM control (18–21 min vs. 17m26s), failing the predeclared 5% improvement threshold.
Recursive basetemp cleanup on treatment runs failed due to intentionally owner-nonwritable snapshot fixture trees that required permission restoration before removal.
Nested pytest cacheprovider leak in patchset 3 caused test collection divergence on Ubuntu; adding -p no:cacheprovider to the subprocess resolved the issue.
Final merged change 1806 reverted the RAM-disk lifecycle and restored both default and integration pytest tiers to runner.temp with unchanged selectors, worker counts, timeouts, and assertions.
Storage placement hypothesis did not reduce runner occupancy; the import benchmark and git-heavy operations remained the dominant latency driver independent of RAM-disk versus filesystem backing.
